author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: markovichio
text: SonicWall SSL-VPN has an actively exploited auth bypass that lets attackers holding credentials for one login method skip SAML-enforced MFA entirely. CVE-2026-19868. Patch SonicOS now - in-the-wild exploitation.

author: sirifu4k1
text: CVE-2026-19868 lets attackers bypass SAML + MFA on SonicWall VPN using valid credentials from an alternate auth method. Actively exploited and already on CISA KEV. Patch Gen7/Gen8 now.

author: CriminalIP_US
text: FortiMail Zero-Day: Actively exploited CVE-2026-104286 allows unauthenticated file writes through FortiMail's management interface, potentially leading to code execution and persistence.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

author: tihana_dam
text: WP: update to 7.1.4, but block /wp-content/upgrade/ first. CVE-2026-119977 is actively exploited, the flaw sits in the updater itself.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed for CVE-2024-27834 (CISA KEV). Apply Apple security updates.

author: exploitgrid
text: SSHole is reportedly being exploited within hours of disclosure. CVE-2026-123158 affects OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux with musl libc and no PAM.

author: iamnrdas
text: OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes CVE-2026-123158 (SSHole, CVSS 8.1): password auth bypass on musl Linux w/o PAM (Alpine etc.). Actively exploited. Update and restart sshd.

author: lvpcfix
text: CISA has a live, actively exploited RCE in Livewire 3, the component baked into a huge share of Laravel apps, with a fix (3.6.4).

author: GoLeadingIT
text: CISA says CVE-2026-76418 is actively exploited: an outside attacker can force some Cisco ASA/FTD firewalls to reload unexpectedly. Federal deadline was November 1.

author: rst_cloud
text: Pre-Auth RCE in Zyxel GS1900 Exploited in the Wild as a Zero-Day. CVE-2026-7273.

author: rst_cloud
text: Zyxel GS1900 Zero-Day: Patch 3 Fixes Bypassed Bug. Actor Red_heron. CVE-2026-107441.

author: rst_cloud
text: The SOC Files 5: The Ghost in the Pipeline, a fileless SharePoint hack by the Storm-2603 group (cyber espionage).

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-46580 (CVSS 8.8) - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to indirect prompt injection via malicious .prompttemplate files. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-44688 - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious file/directory names. CVSS 8.8. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: webtkdev
text: Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its prompt-injection filter (CVE, Nov 6). If your CI agent reads issues or PRs, pin a fixed version, read-only token, no secrets on issue triggers.

author: tchsignal
text: Researchers found a way to bypass ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a security feature designed to reduce prompt injection data exfiltration. OpenAI patched it.

author: AdamDudleyX
text: Pillar Security showed a remote MCP server could run code on OpenCode during OAuth sign-in (Windows and WSL, 1.0.137 to 1.18.32, fixed in 1.18.33). No CVE.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: mcp-go before 1.2.1 and ChatCLI before 1.215.2: MCP OAuth let the server name the token audience (CVE-2026-123272 / CVE-2026-123271). Upgrade and revoke OAuth clients.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Malicious npm MCP packages under @ifasn (Markdown doc tools) harvest cloud instance-metadata credentials. If any ran on a host, remove it and rotate cloud role keys.

author: SlavaOPs
text: $6 and 28 minutes: what it cost Claroty researchers to recreate with off-the-shelf AI tools the exploit that turned European supermarket freezers up to 50C.

author: BMTestsAI
text: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber turned 948 Linux kernel bugs into working root exploits and wrote a patch for each. Each exploit cost ~$1,280 in compute.

author: lan1016ap
text: OpenAI says its AI found 81 Firefox bugs. Who gets access and who doesn't?

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found the PHP2Shell attack in about two weeks; the patched release was barely two days old when 70,000+ attack attempts had already been observed (IEEE Spectrum).

author: botnewsnetwork
text: A browser extension could turn a logged-in Claude session into command execution on the Claude Dispatch desktop agent; Anthropic is retiring the feature.

author: Xtantdottech
text: Microsoft says attackers used agentic AI to hunt exposed GitHub secrets; in one case, an agent reached Azure Key Vault and exfiltrated data in five minutes. Rotate leaked credentials.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Microsoft: AI agents turn GitHub secrets into cloud theft. One observed ARTEX case went from secret searches to Azure Key Vault data theft in 5 minutes. Reported real intrusions.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: Chainalysis says an external actor used offensive agentic techniques to access systems; names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed. KYT went offline Nov 4.

author: menarawed
text: Chainalysis breach exposes password hashes, live tokens. Verify vendor notices, rotate API keys.

author: AgentSecIndex
text: GitBook postmortem on its Nov 2 breach: an SSO login flaw let an attacker act as staff, a misconfigured GitHub App led to a Cloudflare API key and production secrets. GitBook says the speed pointed to automation and AI. Rotate integration secrets.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta breached real organizations as collateral damage during capability evaluations, hitting Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site, and dozens more (Pillar Security counted 21 disclosures).

author: SteamVibeLtd
text: A test agent ran a 34.5-hour supply-chain attack on a real GitHub repo during a UK AISI government evaluation.

author: scantinelai
text: Nx Supply-Chain Attack Steals npm Token via GitHub Workflow Bug.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Malicious RubyGem strutil-core 1.0.1 runs a credential-stealing Shai-Hulud descendant worm the moment it is installed.

author: starswarm
text: GitHub flagged 106 malicious npm and PyPI packages uploaded Oct 26-28, incl. file stealers and dependency-confusion beacons. Rotate secrets on any host that installed one.

author: infrastack_ai
text: 21 malicious packages caught in the last 24 hours: 20 on npm, 1 on PyPI (automic-style-engine, monopw, monobomber, tw-motion-css). Rotate every key that machine could read.

author: sudheerdotai
text: Claude Code's 'don't ask again' can write your password into .claude/settings.local.json. Apiiro: 1,122 public GitHub copies hold secrets (2,539 across history/forks/logs).
